top_choice_rationale: P001 credits Katori and Ye for the magic-wavelength optical lattice clock and its realization at the 1e-18 level. It is a distinct enabling invention, not a repetition of the 2005 comb or 2012 ion-control prizes, and independent Sr and Yb clocks in several laboratories establish maturity. Its two-name allocation is stated the same way by every member, whereas the Higgs entry has no agreed trio. The Higgs is the larger result, so I rank both Higgs trios above no award, with Virdee (P002) ahead of Della Negra (P003) on the construction-through-first-data principle that matches my opening proposal.
recusal_note: Possible perceived tie on P001: a doctoral-period research stay in John Hall's laboratory, with which Jun Ye is associated; no documented collaboration with Katori or Ye. Lund and WACQT quantum-technology ties are not relevant to the credited names in P001 to P003. The committee may record this; five other members hold P001 first, so my ballot is not needed for it.
